style: cute 3D animated character, soft Pixar-like lighting, warm colors, smooth camera, kids friendly, 8 seconds

characters.Pofi: a small fluffy orange bear cub with a green scarf, big round eyes
characters.Mimi: a tiny red frog with a yellow raincoat

episodes.title: Son Kurabiye
episodes.summary: Pofi tek kalan kurabiyeyi bulur ve Mimi'ye açtığını fark edip paylaşır.
scenes: Pofi the fluffy orange bear cub finds a single cookie on a wooden kitchen table, stomach rumbling, warm sunlight through the window
Pofi looks at Mimi the tiny red frog sitting sadly by the door, then breaks the cookie in two
Pofi and Mimi happily share the cookie, sparkles in the air, cozy room

episodes.title: Yağmurlu Gün
episodes.summary: Pofi şemsiyesini yağmurda ıslanan Mimi ile paylaşır.
scenes: Pofi walks on a rainy forest path holding a small red umbrella, puddles splashing, soft rain
Mimi the red frog in a yellow raincoat shivers under a tree, Pofi notices and hurries over
Pofi and Mimi walk together under one umbrella, rain stops, a rainbow appears

episodes.title: Kayıp Balon
episodes.summary: Mimi'nin balonu uçar, Pofi ve Mimi birlikte onu bulur.
scenes: Mimi the red frog loses a blue balloon in a sunny meadow, balloon floats up into a bright sky
Pofi the orange bear cub runs through tall grass pointing at the balloon, Mimi hopping behind
The balloon snags on a tree branch, Pofi lifts Mimi up and she grabs it, both laughing

episodes.title: Uyku Şarkısı
episodes.summary: Pofi uyuyamayan Mimi'yi ay ışığında yumuşak bir ninniyle uyutur.
scenes: Moonlit bedroom, Mimi the red frog tosses in a tiny bed, stars twinkling outside the window
Pofi the orange bear cub sits beside the bed humming softly, floating glowing notes in the air
Mimi falls asleep smiling, Pofi tucks a blanket around her, camera slowly pulls back to the night sky

episodes.title: Büyük Dalga
episodes.summary: Pofi denizde büyük dalgadan korkar, Mimi'nin yardımıyla cesaret bulur.
scenes: Pofi the orange bear cub stands on a sunny beach looking nervously at a big blue wave
Mimi the red frog takes Pofi's paw, encouraging him, gentle music-like sparkles on the water
Pofi and Mimi ride the small wave together on a floating surfboard, splashes of water, bright smiles
